brief: paperclipai/paperclip: Breakout opportunity. Open-source platform to monitor, debug, and orchestrate AI agents.

items.name: paperclipai/paperclip
items.one_liner: Open-source platform to monitor, debug, and orchestrate AI agents
items.pain_point: Dev teams building AI agents lack visibility into production behavior, making debugging and optimization painful. Engineering leads at AI-first companies pay for observability tooling.
app_ideas: Agent observability dashboard with real-time tracing, latency metrics, and failure alerts for AI pipelines
Visual workflow builder for chaining LLM calls with retry logic, rate limiting, and cost tracking
Agent cost optimizer that identifies expensive LLM usage patterns and suggests cheaper alternatives
items.monetization: B2B SaaS with free tier for indie devs, paid per-seat for teams with SSO, audit logs, and advanced analytics
items.why_now: AI agent adoption is accelerating rapidly but management/observability tooling is still nascent, creating massive whitespace
